items.titleEn: Kroger and Instacart Bundle Groceries and Prescriptions in One Delivery
items.summaryEn: Δ document.getElementById( "ak_js_1" ).setAttribute( "value", ( new Date() ).getTime() ); This capability is delivered through the company’s websites and apps, and it is powered by grocery technology company Instacart , according to the release. Eligible prescriptions are filled and verified by Kroger pharmacy teams, secured in tamper-resistant packaging and delivered directly from the local store to the customer’s door by an Instacart shopper. Customers can choose to have the delivery handed directly to them or left at their door, the release said.
